## What changed

**`lib/content-type.js`** — the parameter parser now implements `parameter-value = ( token / quoted-string )`:

- `keyValuePairsReg` gained a quoted-string alternative, tried before the unquoted one, matching a full `"…"` whose content follows the `qdtext` / `quoted-pair` ranges from RFC 9110 §5.6.4. Built with `new RegExp` from a named `quotedStringSource` so the character ranges stay readable as `\uXXXX` escapes.
- A matched quoted-string has its enclosing DQUOTEs stripped and its quoted-pairs unescaped via `quotedPairReg`.
- An unterminated quoted value is now dropped instead of being stored under the `'invalid quoted string'` sentinel (the `value.length < 2` guard also covers a lone `"`).
- `toString()` re-escapes `"` and `\` when re-serializing values. **This is one addition beyond the issue's stated change list:** unescaping on parse without re-escaping on serialize would emit a malformed header for a value containing a quote (`foo="a"b"`), and `reply.send()` feeds `toString()` straight into the response header. Values now round-trip.

**`test/content-type.test.js`** — three new unit tests (semicolon inside quotes, no leaked `charset`, quoted-pair unescaping plus round-trip), and `skips invalid quoted string parameters` updated to expect `baz` dropped.

**`test/internals/reply.test.js`** — integration test asserting `charset=utf-8` is still appended for `application/json; name="a=b;charset=fake"`.

## Verification

Confirmed the bug and the fix side by side — the old regex parses `name="a=b;charset=fake"` into `[["name","\"a=b"],["charset","fake\""]]`, so the phantom `charset` satisfied `parameters.has('charset')` and suppressed the default; the new parser yields `[["name","a=b;charset=fake"]]`.

- `test/content-type.test.js`, `test/internals/reply.test.js`, `test/internals/request.test.js`: 110/110 pass.
- `test/diagnostics-channel/*.test.js`: 15/15 — run per COMPLEX.md's rule for the reply path. I did not modify `lib/reply.js` itself (only read it) and the `onSend`/`preSerialization` ordering and `sent`/`hijacked` invariants are untouched. Its co-change partner `lib/request.js` consumes `ContentType` only via `.mediaType`/`.parameters`, so it needed no change; its tests pass.
- `test/content-type-parser.test.js`, `test/custom-parser*.test.js`: 68/68.
- Full suite: 2277/2283. The 2 failures are environmental and pre-existing, not caused by this change: `test/plugin.4.test.js` cannot resolve the `@sinonjs/fake-timers` devDependency (not installed here), and `test/https/custom-https-server.test.js` fails inside undici with `invalid onRequestStart method` before a request is even dispatched.
- Backtracking check: 50 KB unterminated-quote and all-backslash inputs parse in ~1 ms; the two inner alternatives are disjoint on their first character, so the repetition is deterministic.

Two things I could not run because the commands needed approval: `npm run lint` (eslint/`standard`) and `npm run test:types` (tstyche). The change adds no type surface, but the lint pass is unverified.
